response.original_title: A Clear Guide to GEICO App
response.overview: Updated November 22, 2026  1-888-788-9033 is the bill-pay help line for GEICO: call for GEICO app, with the policy number ready and the receipt kept.  For GEICO app, 1-888-788-9033 checks the policy number and completes it, with any card fee named up front. 1-888-788-9033 walks GEICO mobile app from the policy number to a receipt, and names any charge before it runs. With GEICO mobile app payment, give 1-888-788-9033 the policy number and a source; a card adds a small fee, a bank draft does not. For anything a screen will not finish, 1-888-788-9033 takes it by phone from the policy number.
